notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
- Added hints for the trickier achievements in Endless Mode. My hint is, you'll have to go beyond the game itself. Truly meta.
- Fixed a couple broken achievements (integers weren't being added correctly)
- You can now re-do a few specific scenes that give achievements from the main game in Endless Mode instead of having to start the game over.

This update also begins to fix the notes system with a new backend. Another update will come out soon that will hopefully 100% fix all of the issues related to it.


- Meiri
